title: UAI-TREM: Unravelling Additive and Indirect genetic effects with Time-dependent Random Effect Models
description: UAI-TREM (Unravelling Additive and Indirect genetic effects with Time-dependent Random Effect Models) is an R engine for genetic evaluation. This record holds its established models: the animal model and repeatability, direct-maternal, sire and maternal-grandsire, reaction norms on an environmental gradient, several traits, single-step genomics with the exact or the APY inverse of G, ssSNPBLUP, metafounders and a block Gibbs sampler for Gaussian and binary traits, with quality control of phenotypes and genotypes and tools for selection decisions. The numerics are written in the package itself, in C++ compiled by R CMD INSTALL, with no run-time dependency.
